using Base64
using Statistics
using LinearAlgebra

function main()
    # Read directory path from stdin
    input_str = read(stdin, String)
    
    # Check if input is empty
    if isempty(input_str)
        error("No directory path provided.")
    end
    
    dir_path = chomp(input_str)
    
    # Validate directory exists
    if !isdir(dir_path)
        error("Directory '$dir_path' does not exist.")
    end
    
    # Get list of files (excluding directories)
    files = filter(isfile, readdir(dir_path))
    
    # Function to clean filename
    function clean_name(name)
        # Keep only alphanumeric characters
        return filter(c -> isalnum(c), name)
    end
    
    # Process files
    new_names = []
    for name in files
        new_name = clean_name(name)
        if isempty(new_name)
            # Skip files that become empty after cleaning
            continue
        end
        push!(new_names, new_name)
    end
    
    # Write results to stdout, one per line
    for name in new_names
        println(name)
    end
end
